_comment: NX-035 slice 3: scripts/deploy/file_backup_install.sh on APP_HOST (root; steps 2-6, NX-035-file-backup.md §6). Copy to a private 0600 root file and fill in. Order: --prepare (prints the public key), DATA_HOST step 1 (file_backup_data_host.sh), install_repo2_secrets.sh files, then the install with recorder<TAB>password and repo1<TAB>password on stdin. python is the host-health venv's interpreter, /opt/nexloop/host-health/current/venv/bin/python (it has psycopg; a link chain is fine). memory_deny_write_execute as the host-health install of this host. restic_archive is the official restic_<version>_linux_amd64.bz2 of versions.lock.json, downloaded by the owner (its sha256 is checked). database is DATA_HOST's PG over hostssl (verify-full; sslrootcert the server CA on this host, copied next to the DSN). repo1 is DATA_HOST's sshd: its address, port and host key line (ssh-keyscan read on DATA_HOST itself, never trusted from the network), path the restore journal's restic repository inside the chroot. repo2_init true lets step 5 initialise the repo2 of the files once.
